text: 🎬 Josh O'Connor is a Bond finalist, and the shortlist just got interesting Josh O'Connor is reportedly one of four actors still in the running for 007, with final screen tests underway. The other three names haven't surfaced. He isn't the safe pick. 'Challengers' showed he can do charm with a blade behind it, and 'La Chimera' showed he can carry a film on pure scruffy melancholy. That's a Bond with more Fleming in him than a box-office stat. Whether Amazon MGM wants a star or a face the audience hasn't priced in yet is the real question, and O'Connor is the answer to the second one.

🎬 'Clayface' gets bloody in Gotham, but /Film finds no shape in it James Watkins , who made 'Eden Lake' and 'Speak No Evil', gives DC an R-rated body-horror spin-off. /Film says the gore is there but the film has no personality of its own. That's the risk with villain solo movies. After 'Joker', a bleak tone only works when it belongs to someone. Blood alone doesn't make a Gotham story distinct. Tom Rhys Harries has a transformation-heavy role, and Watkins knows how to build dread, so a limp result would point at the script. The cast also includes Naomi Ackie, Max Minghella, Eddie Marsan and Aaron Paul. ✈️ Add to watchlist
